text.p: These are the leading stories in the Skopje press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Flu epidemic reaches its peak with over 600 patients in epidemiological clinics in Skopje.

- President Kiro Gligorov attends Orthodox Christmas liturgy in St Kliment cathedral in Skopje. Macedonian Archbishop Mihail prays for "the unity of the Macedonian people, peace and wisdom of politicians."
- Workers of Suvenir weapons factory near Skopje urge defence ministry to resolve their financial situation and demand payment of their August 1996 outstanding wages.
- Workers of Makedonka textile industry in Stip again on strike. They accuse management of theft and ask for payment of outstanding July 1996 wages.
